subject: reasoning
question: Seven friends D, E, F, U, V, W and X are sitting in a straight line facing the north. Only three people are seated to the left of D. Only E is seated to the right of W. Only three people are seated between W and X. V is seated at some place to the left of U but at some place to the right of F. How many people are seated between F and U?11035
solution:
**Given:**

 
• Seven friends D, E, F, U, V, W, and X are sitting in a straight line facing the North.
 
• Only three people are seated to the left of D.
 
• Only E is seated to the right of W.
 
• Only three people are seated between W and X.
 
• V is seated at some place to the left of U but at some place to the right of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20f48056eea34e985384c743897a8510123e069803f1ddbb0f851c2707eefb9d.png] 

People between F (pos 1) and U (pos 5) are: **X, V, and D**.

Total count = 3.

Therefore, **three** people are seated between F and U.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
